svg.aria-label: B1-05 — the negative control: an excellent fit to the wrong window
svg.desc: Semilog plot of the same synthetic response, but over a window at dimensionless time 1 to 10 instead of the declared one. The points still lie on a straight line to the eye and to the fit statistics: R² is 0.999302 and the residual standard error is 0.310 psi. The recovered permeability is 54.6752 md against a known 50.0 md, an error of 9.35 percent, and the skin is off by 0.426. The table sets both against the thresholds the protocol declared.

svg.text: This is the figure B1 exists to produce. A high R² is a statement about how well a line fits points, and it remains high when the line has no business being

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: there. The acceptance criterion catches it; the fit statistic does not, and neither does the eye.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: What would have caught it in practice is the diagnostic in B1-01: over this window the derivative has not yet flattened, so the regime the straight line

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

svg.text: assumes is visibly absent. That is what the derivative is for, and it is why the specialized plot is never read on its own.
